$comment: Run config for the Manim video harness. Read by init.sh, scripts/*, videos/*/render.py and tests/. Edit here rather than hardcoding quality flags in scenes.

motion_blur.$comment: OFF by default on every profile, deliberately. A frame-blend pass smears the WHOLE frame, so on a camera move it reads as judder and slow motion rather than polish. Clean motion here comes from easing (lib/motion.py) and comet trails (lib/effects.py), not from blur. Turn a profile's motion_blur on only for a specific shot that needs it, and look at the result.
